prompt: sum_range(start, stop) returns the sum of all integers from start to stop INCLUSIVE on both ends. Currently returns the wrong value when stop equals start.
last_n(items, n) returns the last n elements of a list. Currently returns one too few elements.
is_singleton(v) returns True if v is None. Currently returns the wrong value for the None case.

find_first(items, target) returns the index of the first item equal to target, or -1. Currently uses identity comparison instead of equality, so it misses values that compare equal but are not the same object.
mean(values) returns the arithmetic mean. Currently raises ZeroDivisionError on empty input; should return 0.0.
first_value(d) returns the first value of dict d. Currently raises StopIteration on empty dict; should return None.
reverse_string(s) returns s reversed. Currently returns s unchanged.
increment_all(values) returns a new list with each element +1. Currently returns a copy of the input unchanged.
word_count(text) returns a dict mapping each whitespace-separated word to its count. Currently raises NameError due to a typo.
normalize_email(email) lowercases and strips whitespace. Currently raises ValueError when @ IS present; should raise ValueError ONLY when @ is missing.
